method: All 49 Artlist MP4s decoded. Twelve evenly distributed frames extracted per clip; visual screening uses six distributed frames per clip, and all twelve for Superman and the seven inconclusive clips. This does not certify every intervening frame or professional technique. All 25 free YMove MP4s downloaded and decoded; the fourteen active overlay clips had twelve distributed frames visually inspected.
